gemma_diagnostic.status: DIAGNOSTIC ONLY — not LIVE-PROVIDER evidence (direct Cloudflare account API via the cloudflare-carup MCP, outside the deployed runtime and the governed harness)
gemma_diagnostic.why: the deployed proof (run 37705240258) got ai_status ai_unavailable from POST /api/marketplace/ai/buyer-assistant after 13.35 s; the buyer assistant bounds the gateway at AI_TIMEOUT_MS = 12000 and swallows the AI_TIMEOUT without an ai_reason
gemma_diagnostic.model_schema: chat_template_kwargs.enable_thinking: boolean, default true ('Whether to enable reasoning for this model')

call_1_default_thinking.request: the buyer assistant's exact system prompt + user prompt (synthetic proof question) + JSON instruction, temperature 0, max_tokens 4096

gemma_diagnostic.conclusion: systematic, not transient: with default reasoning Gemma needs ~16 s for this request class, beyond the product's 12 s bound, so the deployed advisory path degrades to deterministic every time. Remediation (a code change, not made in REL-01): send enable_thinking=false for advisory JSON/text calls (or raise the bound to cover reasoning), and surface ai_reason 'ai_timeout' on the degraded answer.
